The '''Gannymeda system''' was a part of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="TEA" /> and [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] regions.<ref name="Region" /> It was the origin point of the social group known as the [[Gannymedan]]s.<ref name="Bounty Hunter" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gannymeda [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-8.<ref name="TEA" />
